STRAIGHT ANSWERS

A few things
you might be wondering.

Start with clarity about what happens next.

How we work ↗
What would I actually receive?

A scoped review would produce a plain-English report with evidence labels, priorities, suggested actions and owners. See the fictional sample report for the format.

Are services and prices available now?

The service is in preparation. Figures shown are planning benchmarks, with scope, availability, VAT and commercial terms still to be confirmed. No payment is taken here.

Can you work with my existing IT provider?

The proposed approach is collaborative. A useful review clarifies responsibilities and gives you a plan to discuss with your existing support.

Will you need confidential client records?

The first conversation does not require clinical notes, client names, passwords or recovery codes. Any later access must be justified and agreed within the written scope.

Can I book a call online?

The calendar is not connected yet. The first-conversation page explains what to prepare and what a review discussion would cover.
